items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you meet her? [INTERVIEWEE] I sure did.

ctx.x: She would do more for me than she would for her father. She went right in 129th Street where we used to hang out, after hours, and she was drinking wine. You know, we'd sit back and the musicians play and sang... So I used to tell her - I talked to her all the time and I'd say, 'Billie, now don't drink too much wine because you've got to sing.....' She made me a promise that she wouldn't do it, and she didn't. She was just a good kid. Her stepmother was the cause of all of it.
Her stepmother? Did you meet her?
